en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard with two photographs side by side. The left image shows an old stone church facade with arches and a smaller dome behind, labeled as St. Dimitrion in Mistra. The right image shows a balcony or loggia with several people standing and sitting, supported by stone arches below, looking out over a landscape. Printed French text at the top right identifies the location as Greece, Peloponnese, Mistra.
